admission.justification: Separately owned serving composition, observation scheduling and safety operations must not mistake missing page interest or launch permission for permission to hide required observations; operation-level tests guard the distinct boundary.

applicability: The serving lifetime periodic provider safety metrics loop observing labelled stacks.
conditions: Sample, record, degradation evaluation and compaction keep their existing accounted offload, drain, stop callback and sample interval.
Launch authorization and fleet presence remain separate.
exclusions: No fleet-absence or retirement mechanism is introduced.
Controlled-loop tests do not demonstrate native container launches or installation performance.

origin.handoffEntry: L166 periodic provider safety after R1 withdrawal

statement: Launch authority is not evidence of fleet retirement, so the original periodic sample/record/degradation/compact sequence observes labelled leftovers regardless of page interest, empty/revoked authority, restart or decoding failure, while launch refusal stays separate.
